audit_timing: After source-only parser run, before v14 natural QA predictions; no v14 QA answers/references or model outputs inspected for this audit.

provenance.reviewer: model-assisted independent-role reviewer within shared research session
provenance.prior_familiarity: Reviewer authored v13 reference/context reviews and inspected four masked Plug answers during adjudication. v14 sample was built from source pages without reopening QA references, questions, grading files or outputs; selection is therefore development and not blind or held out.
provenance.source_fidelity_limit: Judgments concern frozen extracted page spans, including tagged model-assisted image-table transcriptions. They are not independent certification of PDF extraction fidelity.
provenance.selection: Purposive coverage across both histories and all four document versions, with known difficult page structures; no random or representative sampling claim.

frozen_semantics.table_header_context: Exact pre-first-aligned-row band; no inferred cell-to-year mapping or claim that one label governs every row.
frozen_semantics.unit_context: Exact unit text retained with exceptions and qualifiers; no numeric conversion.
frozen_semantics.section_context: Copies an explicit same-page preceding heading; no numeric-scope claim.
frozen_semantics.footnote_context: Copies adjacent explicitly marked note with unique marker within the region; not a claim that note applies to all rows.
frozen_semantics.relation_coverage_vs_raw_text: Required-probe counts measure accepted explicit context-link coverage. Header text may already occur inside a raw source block despite unresolved attachment; raw co-presence can help a parent baseline but is not accepted attachment coverage or a guarantee under a context budget.

gate_recommendation.scope: Allows a bounded development comparison only under the frozen context-only baseline claim, subject to the independent reader control gate.
limitations: Ten of seventeen required context relations are missing; conservative behavior has substantial coverage cost.
One mixed-scope header region cannot be used as semantic metadata for every row.
Seven accepted section links originate from page footers and can waste evidence budget.
A likelihood equation/prose block is a false table-region candidate, though its header link is withheld.
No source-only audit result guarantees that retrieved or packed contexts retain required text.
The sample is purposive and reused familiar development material.
